tables.title: TDES0 normal descriptor (read format)
tables.text_helper: Table 821, "TDES0 normal descriptor (read format)", in section 76.10.3 (Transmit descriptor) on page 4151. Columns: Bit, Name, Description. 1 data row(s). Notes: 1. TSO header means from the Ethernet source address to the end of the TCP header.

rows:
Buffer 1 address pointer or TSO header(1) address pointer
These bits indicate either the physical address of buffer 1 or the TSO header 
address pointer when the following bits are set:
– TSE bit of TDES3
– FD bit of TDES3
notes: 1. TSO header means from the Ethernet source address to the end of the TCP header.
